title: Man Shot After Hitting Trooper With Metal Clamp During Child Custody Dispute
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Constantia, N.Y. — On March 21, 2025, members of the Oswego County Sheriff's Office and the New York State Police responded to a house in Constantia, Oswego County, following a 911 call for a welfare check and to serve, 32-year-old Miles Dignean, with an order of protection to remove a 3-year-old child from his custody. Officers told Dignean a family member was coming to get the child. After that he became uncooperative and tried to prevent them from taking the child. NYSP Trooper Junyla Sabari managed to remove the child from Dignean. A struggle ensued during the encounter, and Dignean grabbed a steel C-Clamp, hitting Trooper Junyla Sabari in the head. The clamp was 7 inches by 17 inches and weighed 8 pounds. Deputy Corey Whitney, who has been with the office for 11 years, fired a taser at Dignean but it was not effective. Deputy Whitney then fired his gun twice, hitting Dignean. The child was removed from the scene and placed in the care of family members. Dignean was transported to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead.
